lines: Usage has dipped lately. Taylor played 68% of snaps over his last 3 games, down from 75% on the season, and carried 13.3 times per game versus 17.1.
The coach said the game plan will be built around Taylor and Richardson both as run threats, and Taylor should absorb work with McGowan down.
Wk 12 is vs NYG, who allow the 27th-most PPR points per game to RBs, but IND's implied team total is 17.5 points.
